scientific_limitations: Even ring, strict downhill single flips, J>0 and 0<h<2J only; excludes hitting probabilities and finite-temperature dynamics. The critical-field Lucas result is prior art, not this claim. The 1989 Masui et al. full paper was not accessible; residual priority risk remains.
title: Perrin census of weak-field blocked states on a staggered Ising ring
